Name: Every Issue Barbers. Style: Fades, classic cuts, beards and hot towel shaves. Town: Nottingham, 22 Hockley Row (example), Nottingham NG1.
Hours: Sunday: 10am till 3pm. Tuesday: 6pm till 9am. Wednesday and Friday: 9am till 6pm. Thursday: 9am till 8pm. Saturday: 8am till 5pm. Closed Mondays.
Barbers: Marcus (the owner: skin fades, Afro and textured hair, designs); Dan (classic cuts, beards and hot towel shaves); Jordan (cuts and kids); Amira (cuts, grey blending and beard colour).

Prices: Classic cut £18.00, Skin fade £22.00, Cut and beard £28.00, Beard trim £12.00, Hot towel shave £20.00, Kids' cut £13.00, Grey blending from £25.00, Beard colour £15.00,  £0.00, Free thing £0.00.
A £5 deposit is taken when booking if they can, and comes off the price; if not, they pay in the shop. Free to cancel or move with 24 hours' notice; later than that, the deposit is kept.
Walk-ins: welcome when a chair is free. Kids: kids' price under 12; under-16s with an adult.

Access: Step-free from the street, with room for a wheelchair at every chair. Ask for a quiet time and we will book one. Parking: There's no parking at the shop: the Lace Market and Victoria Centre car parks are a few minutes' walk. Products: We sell the wax, clay, oils and beard balm we use in the shop. Tips: Tips are welcome, and the barbers keep all of them. Jobs: We're always happy to hear from barbers and apprentices: drop your details in, or leave a message. Home visits: We don't do home visits.
